caption: A flag hanging limp from a pole outside a school lifts and streams out as a strong wind picks up.

sa.check: A flag hangs limp from a pole outside a school.
The flag lifts and streams out.
The wind comes first and the flag responds after.

pc.expect: The flag lifts as the wind picks up and points the same way as other things blown.
pc.fail: It streams while trees and grass are still; or points opposite to other wind signs; or lifts before any sign of wind.

pc.expect: It stretches out downwind and ripples along its length.
pc.fail: It is rigid like a board; or stays limp while strong wind signs are visible; or stretches longer.

pc.expect: It hangs below its clips when limp and lifts along the wind when blown.
pc.fail: It rises above the pole top; or floats off; or hangs out sideways with no wind.

pc.expect: It streams out on the downwind side.
pc.fail: It flips between sides randomly; or wraps around the pole and stays; or streams into the wind.

pc.expect: One flag on one pole keeps its number.
pc.fail: The flag duplicates; or passes through the pole; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The flag's colours, the pole and the school stay the same.
pc.fail: The flag changes colours; or the pole changes; or the school rearranges.
